forum.title: how to generate cpp project from stm32cube Mx
forum.best_answer_content:
Hello ​@siva\_28

First make sure **STM32CubeIDE** is selected as the toolchain

![](https://uploads-eu-west-1.insided.com/stmicroelectronics-en/attachment/59d0a8ff-14e1-4c20-869e-270c75d63280.png)

After generating the code with **STM32CubeMX ,** then open the project in **STM32CubeIDE**, right-click the project, and choose **Convert to C++**.

![](https://uploads-eu-west-1.insided.com/stmicroelectronics-en/attachment/84dbf04a-488d-40e8-ac89-13b7ae70d7b4.png)
forum.content_text: after selecting the pins from cube MX, it will generate code in c but i want that in cpp
forum.author: siva_28

scraped_replies.html:
Hello ​@siva_28 

STM32CubeMX mainly generates C code, but you can still use it very easily in a C++ project by generating the hardware initialization code with CubeMX, keeping those generated files unchanged as much as possible, and then adding your own .cpp and .hpp files for the application logic.

BR, Souhaib
scraped_replies.author: Souhaib MAZHOUD
